title: Positive: webhooks, internal jobs, sandbox gates and guest order tokens are well protected
expected: Signed, idempotent webhooks; secret-protected jobs; no fake payment surface in production; unguessable guest links.
actual: Stripe events are signature-checked and claimed atomically (duplicates ignored, failed processing released for redelivery). Chapa webhooks: HMAC with length check and timingSafeEqual. Internal jobs: 404 unless a ≥32-char secret is set, hashed constant-time compare. All sandbox payment routes return 404 in production. Guest order links: 256-bit random tokens stored as SHA-256, rate-limited.
